'''Specter Squadron''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Specter Squadron was stationed at [[Renforra Base]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and was commanded by [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] before he was reassigned to lead [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].

==History==
Specter [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCG-Gold1" /> The squadron was composed of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] starfighters that were painted [[Color/Legends|gray]] with white trim. The squadron's Y-wings produced a green exhaust from their [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering jets]].<ref name="PocketModels">{{PocketModel|set=Base Set|cardname=Specter Squadron Y-wing|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/ship06a.jpg}}</ref>

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Specter Squadron was stationed at [[Renforra Base]]. [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]] led the squadron,<ref name="CCG-Dutch">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Dutch}}</ref> piloting the Y-wing designated as "[[Gold 1|Specter 1]]."<ref name="CCG-Gold1" /> Vander was eventually transferred to [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] where he was placed in command of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]]. He continued to wear a [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]] that proudly displayed Specter Squadron's emblem.<ref name="CCG-Dutch" />

==Organization==
Specter Squadron's emblem was a stylized black shape with a central yellow section resembling an iris, overlaid on a grey cloud. Pilots in the squadron, such as its [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] Jon "Dutch" Vander, had the emblem painted on their flight helmets.<ref name="CCG-Dutch" /> Specter Squadron was outfitted with Y-wings,<ref name="PocketModels" /> which Vander preferred to fly over other starfighters.<ref name="CCG-Dutch" /> Vander was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] while attempting to launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] into the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[Support Services]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] also displayed the Specter Squadron emblem on his helmet when flying [[Red Five/Legends|Red Five]] with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Frix">{{DB|character|grizzfrix|Frix, Grizz}}</ref> Frix died while engaging an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] at point blank range during the engagement.<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Specter Squadron was first referenced in the [[Premiere Unlimited]] base set for [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]<ref name="Premiere">''[[Premiere Unlimited]]''</ref> released in December [[1995]].<ref name="Decipher">{{Decipher|url=starwars/whatisit/timeline.html|text=''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game Product Timeline}}</ref> The squadron was featured in the flavor text on the cards Dutch<ref name="CCG-Dutch" /> and Gold 1.<ref name="CCG-Gold1" /> Specter Squadron was later represented by a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="PocketModels" />

The flavor text on the Dutch card indicates that the black shape with the yellow eye emerging from a gray cloud shape is the emblem of Specter Squadron.<ref name="CCG-Dutch" /> This emblem is unique to Dutch at the time of the Battle of Yavin, while other symbols on his helmet are used by other pilots not associated with his former squadron&mdash;including [[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Porkins]] and [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]]. In [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the Specter emblem is visible on Grizz Frix's helmet, indicating his membership of Specter Squadron at some point.<ref name="Frix" />
